name: Metalfab Inc
old_description: Technologically advanced machines provide clients with design flexibility.
about:
Metalfab Inc operates from West Valley City, Utah, where it was founded in 1986. The company is led by President Randall Wright and has grown over four decades into a full-service sheet metal fabrication shop with a 28,000-square-foot facility.

The shop houses capabilities including laser cutting, press brake forming, certified welding, machining, assembly, hardware insertion, tumble deburring, screen printing, and reverse engineering. It handles both prototype and production runs, supported by design assist and CAD drawing services, and offers delivery and shipping.

Metalfab serves customers across a range of industries that require precision sheet metal work, though specific sectors are not listed in its public materials. The company emphasizes turnkey solutions from design through final delivery.

The company states its mission is to exceed customer expectations in quality, delivery, and cost through continuous improvement and customer interaction. It highlights implemented quality monitoring systems throughout all production stages and a track record of on-time, on-budget delivery.
